title: PullRequestClosed
description: A pull request Factorial opened was closed, merged or not: the detail of a PullRequestClosed event (source factorial.triggers) on the factorial-work bus. Emitted by a trigger adapter, as the fact the source system reported. It is not a WorkItem: nothing is asked of Factorial, and it never reaches Intake. Metadata only, never content.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

headBranch.description: The branch the pull request was opened from: one of Factorial's work branches.

merged.description: Whether the pull request was merged when it closed.

mergeCommit.description: When merged: the commit the merge made on the base branch.

by.description: Who merged it, or who closed it without merging: a source-system login.
